feeds.title: PRCA Sports News
feeds.description: Covers the latest news stories, cowboy blogs, world standings, rodeo results, cowboy and livestock bios, and tons of other information. The Professional Rodeo Cowboys Association (PRCA) is the oldest and biggest rodeo-sanctioning body in the world.

feeds.title: Rodeo Life
feeds.description: The Rodeo News is the pioneer for quality information and coverage connecting all rodeo enthusiasts. The Rodeo News offers outstanding personalized customer relations, fair pricing, and mutually beneficial growth opportunities.

feeds.title: World Champions Rodeo Alliance Blog
feeds.description: Articles, News, Stories, and Announcements from World Champions Rodeo Alliance (WCRA), a professional sport and entertainment entity created to develop and advance the sport of Rodeo.

feeds.title: WPRA
feeds.description: A source for schedule changes, rules, standings, and news. The Women's Professional Rodeo Association (WPRA) provides opportunities for women across the United States and Canada to compete in the timed events of barrel racing, team roping, breakaway roping, and tie-down roping.

feeds.title: COWGIRL Magazine » Rodeo
feeds.description: Yeehaw! Saddle up for the latest updates in rodeo. From the PRCA to the WPRA to the WNFR, there's always something big going on in Rodeo. COWGIRL is the only nationally distributed Western lifestyle magazine exclusively for women, reaching more than a million female enthusiasts in print and online. Published six times annually and daily online, COWGIRL regularly features stunning original photography and articles about horses and tack, riding, fashion, lifestyle, destinations, amazing homesteads, home décor, and recipes.

feeds.title: Montana Pro Rodeo Blog
feeds.description: We are all about Montana Pro Rodeo since 1979! Keep up with all your Montana PRCA action happening across the state. Check back here for all the latest schedules, results, standings, and news.

feeds.title: RodeoReady Blog
feeds.description: Clay Guardipee specializes in PRCA and rodeo photography but has recently taken a liking to weddings, families and senior photography as well. He created RodeoReady to capture all the rodeos he can. Check out his portfolio, rodeo event stories, travels and more!

feeds.title: Silver Spurs Rodeo Blog
feeds.description: The Silver Spurs Rodeo is the largest rodeo east of the Mississippi and has been a tradition in Kissimmee since July 4th,1944! Read more information about the Silver Spurs Rodeo and our history, the sport of rodeo, and more on the Silver Spurs Rodeo blog!

feeds.title: Cowboy Lifestyle Network
feeds.description: Read the latest information and stories about the world of rodeo, horse competitions, western life, and everything cowboy! At Cowboy Lifestyle Network, you'll find news, exciting videos, photos, informative articles, and entertaining stories about the professionals and fans behind the scenes.

feeds.title: World Championship Junior Rodeo Blog
feeds.description: World Championship Junior Rodeo features Bareback Riding, Saddle Bronc Riding, Bull Riding, Steer Wrestling, Tie Down Roping, Team Roping-Header, Team Roping-Heeler, Ladies Breakaway Roping, Ladies Barrel Racing, Ladies Poles Bending and Ladies Goat Tying. The 2023 Cinch World Championship Junior Rodeo presented by Montana Silversmiths event will award a guaranteed payout of $200,000 and is open to any youth athlete ages 19 and under in two divisions. Find all the championship updates and news in the blog.

feeds.title: Women's Rodeo World Championship Blog
feeds.description: The WRWC is the largest annual purse for a women's rodeo event and will payout more than $750,000 in 2023 while crowning World Champions in the Women's Rodeo disciplines; Team Roping, Breakaway Roping and Barrel Racing. An all-around champion will also be crowned. WRWC is a culmination of a year-long race of women's rodeo events worldwide. Get the up to date news, updates, events information and more here.
